mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 4.0% indicates labor market slack that suppresses wage growth and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in weakening economic activity.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS does not predict negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 or p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month high signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (UNRATE < 4.5% and FEDFUNDS < 3.0%), INDPRO decline does not predict negative 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 or p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL index values above 230 indicate elevated inflation that typically triggers Federal Reserve rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending expectations weaken.
failure_condition: The joint signal of UNRATE rising and PAYEMS falling does not predict negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03 or p > 0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month average indicates weakening manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as economic slowdown risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% from its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 850,000 units signals residential construction contraction, which precedes reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as economic momentum weakens.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is below 850.
